meta.name: arbor
meta.description: Autonomously improve a real artifact (code, training recipe, agent harness, data pipeline, prompt) against an objective and an evaluator, using Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR) from the Arbor paper. Use this whenever someone wants to iteratively optimize something over many experiments without overfitting — e.g. "get my model's eval score up", "improve this agent/harness", "tune this pipeline", "beat the baseline on this benchmark", "run a search over approaches and keep the best", "do an MLE-bench / Kaggle-style optimization", or any long-horizon "make this artifact better and don't just memorize the dev set" task. Trigger it even when the user doesn't say "Arbor" or "hypothesis tree" but describes repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops, branching exploration of competing ideas, or worries about a dev/test gap. Runs Claude itself as the coordinator with subagent executors in isolated git worktrees; for the standalone `arbor` CLI tool see references/arbor-upstream.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自动实验把模型或流程的评分逐步顶高
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为模型或流程的分数头疼,想用自动实验挑出更稳妥的方案
copy.tagline_en: Run experiments to push model or pipeline scores steadily higher
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automatic experiments to improve a model or pipeline and avoid overfitting.

howto.what: 它会自动跑多轮实验改进你已有的产物(代码、训练配方、数据管线、提示词等):把假设、证据和版本记在一棵假设树里,每个假设由子代理在隔离的 git 工作区里单独测试,只有通过独立测试评估器的改动才合并,最后给出报告和可运行的最终产物。
howto.when: 当你有一个可修改的产物、目标和能打分的评估器,并打算反复跑实验改进它时,它会接管;即使不提 Arbor,只要你说「把 eval 分数提上去」,或担心 dev/test 差距,也会触发。

say.text: 帮我改进这个仓库,把 eval 分数提上去
say.note: 它会先确认目标、dev 和 test 评估器

say.text: 对这几个方案做搜索,留下在 test 上更好的那个
say.note: 候选要通过独立的 test 合并门才留下

say.text: 跑一轮 MLE-bench 风格的提交优化,预算 12 个 cycle
say.note: budget 是协调者循环的轮数

howto.what_en: It runs repeated experiment-and-evaluate cycles to improve an existing artifact. A hypothesis tree holds the evidence; each hypothesis is tested in an isolated git worktree, and only changes passing a held-out test evaluator merge.
howto.when_en: Use it when there's a modifiable artifact, an objective and a scorer, and you expect many experiments — e.g. raising an eval score or improving an agent/harness. Also triggers on dev/test-gap worries.

say_en.text: Help me improve this repo and get the eval score up.
say_en.note: It first pins the objective and dev/test evaluators.

say_en.text: Search these approaches and keep the one that's better on test.
say_en.note: Candidates must pass the held-out test merge gate.

say_en.text: Run an MLE-bench style submission optimization with a 12-cycle budget.
